commands.mars.go.missing: The Mars dimension isn't loaded. Check the server log for errors from the mars mod.
commands.mars.back.success: You are back at the world spawn.
block.mars.atmospheric_processor.tooltip: Game-sized idea based on MOXIE and Sabatier
block.mars.water_reclaimer.tooltip: Game-sized version of a real idea. Space stations clean used water so crews can drink it again.
block.mars.oxygen_maker.tooltip: Game-sized version of a real idea. MOXIE, a real instrument on Mars, splits carbon dioxide into oxygen.
block.mars.solar_panel.needs_space: The solar array needs a clear 3 × 3 space around it.
monitor.title: Planetary Monitor
monitor.no_planet: The Monitor has no planet to read here.
monitor.water.no_liquid: No liquid water at this pressure
monitor.plot.rescaled: The graph now goes up to %s. The line looks lower, but the pressure did not drop.
monitor.plot.caption: Air pressure over time
log.storm.warn: Dust storm forming. It reaches the dome in about %s. It should last about %s.
log.storm.onset: The dust storm has reached the dome.
log.storm.end: The dust storm is over. The sky is clearing.
monitor.cause.polar_frost_release: Polar frost gives back: %s per sol
monitor.cause.polar_frost.read_more: On real Mars, about a quarter of the air freezes onto the poles each winter. In spring the dry ice turns back into gas, so the air pressure goes back up.
monitor.estimate.levelling_off: Leveling off: the frost takes back about as much as your machines add.
monitor.estimate.levelling_off.hs: Frost and machines balance near %s. More machines move that balance up.
monitor.oven.tooltip: Bakes soil and releases a little gas. Water comes later.
grant.starting: You have %s × %s in your inventory. Place them, then check Power on the Monitor.
journal.title: Keeper's Journal
journal.list.header: Keeper's Journal (%s entries). /mars journal <number> reads one.
journal.list.empty: Your journal is empty. Entries appear when you reach goals.
journal.no_planet: Your journal belongs to a planet. Go to Mars first.
journal.dome_stable.airmix.title: The air outside
journal.dome_stable.airmix.ms: Outside air: about 95 % carbon dioxide, almost no oxygen, and very thin. You can't breathe it.
earth.gate.dome_stable.title: On Earth
earth.gate.dome_stable.ms: Earth's air pushes on you with more than 100 times the force of Mars's air. You never notice, because the air and fluids inside your body push back with the same pressure.
earth.gate.dome_stable.hs: Earth's air pushes on you with more than 100 times the force of Mars's air. You never notice, because the air and fluids inside your body push back with the same pressure. Earth at sea level is about 101 kPa. Outside Cairn Dome it's about 0.6 kPa. Your dome has to make up the difference.
journal.sky.stylized.title: The sky
journal.sky.stylized.ms: More air scatters more blue light, so the sky slowly turns less tan and more blue. The dust is still there. Nobody has seen a thickened Mars sky. These in-between colors are our best guess, made stronger so you can see them.
journal.band.made_up.title: The purple stripe
journal.band.made_up.ms: A purple dashed stripe marks a machine from our game. Some are made up. Others are small copies of a real idea. Hold your pointer over the machine to see which one.
guidance.effect.expert: Expert: the Monitor does not show the time to a goal.
guidance.expert_refused: Expert is not offered in classroom mode.
guidance.unknown: Unknown level. Use gentle, standard or expert.
block.mars.sulfide_vein.tooltip: Game invention. Mars rocks may hold a little copper, but we do not know of copper veins. We add rare ones so you can build machines.
block.mars.magnetic_ore.tooltip: Game invention. Mars crust is strongly magnetic in places. No one has found ore to make electronics from. Redstone here stands for wiring and magnet material.
block.mars.carbonate_rock.tooltip: Real, but game-sized. Real Mars has carbonate rock in a few places, in craters like Jezero. We make small veins easy to find. Scrubbers making carbonate is a game idea.
block.mars.washed_regolith.tooltip: Real Mars soil holds toxic salts called perchlorates, and they dissolve in water. Washing soil to remove them is game design, not verified.
block.mars.rich_soil.tooltip: Washed regolith mixed with bone meal. Made up for the game: real Mars soil has no life in it.
block.mars.biocrust.tooltip: A stand-in for a crust of living things. Made up for the game. On Earth this takes hundreds of years.
item.mars.biocrust_kit.tooltip: Biocrust kit. Seeds a small patch of living crust. Needs treated soil. Game invention, not real.
item.mars.meadow_kit.tooltip: Tundra meadow kit. Seeds mosses and grasses. Needs soil that biocrust made. Game invention, not real.
item.mars.wetland_kit.tooltip: Wetland margin kit. Seeds reeds beside water. Needs soil that biocrust made. Game invention, not real.
item.mars.forest_kit.tooltip: Cold forest kit. Seeds small trees and shrubs. Needs meadow soil and warm enough air. Game invention, not real.
grant.starter_chest: The lander left you a supply chest with copper, redstone and seeds. Place it and open it.
block.mars.ice_extractor.tooltip: Game-sized version of a real idea. A real research well melts ice underground and pumps the water up. Needs power and ground that is not too cold.
item.mars.heater_coil.tooltip: Iron wire that glows when power runs through it. Machines that make heat need one.
item.mars.filter_cartridge.tooltip: Catches dust before air enters a machine. It clogs, so keep a spare.
item.mars.pump_bearing.tooltip: A steel ring that lets a pump spin. Pumps need them.
gate.supply.dome_stable: Supply note: coils from the lander. Heat needs wire that resists power.
gate.supply.phase_2_begins: Supply note: filters from the lander. Dust must be caught before air enters a machine.
gate.supply.thaw: Supply note: bearings from the lander. A pump that spins needs a bearing.
block.mars.algae_vat.tooltip: Game-sized version of a real idea. Space station plant boxes grow crops under lights in a sealed chamber. Here an algae tank swaps CO2 for oxygen. Needs power, water and warmth.
block.mars.carbon_scrubber.tooltip: Game-sized version of a real idea. The space station has a machine that pulls CO2 from air. The real one lets the CO2 go. Here it is locked into rock. Needs power.
item.mars.sorbent_bed.tooltip: Porous pellets that hold CO2 until they fill. Real ones use zeolite or amine, and are heated to let the CO2 go.
gate.supply.phase_3_begins: Supply note: beds from the lander. Pellets can hold on to what touches them.
